title: The wedding night prayer (Tobit 8)
hookLine: Tobias and Sara pray together before anything else

cards: Remember Sara, the young woman in Media who prayed to die on the same day as Tobit? Here's why.
She had been married seven times, and each husband died on the wedding night, before the marriage began, killed, the book says, by a demon named Asmodeus. Even her father's maid taunted her for it.
On the road, Raphael tells Tobias: she's your kinswoman, and you should marry her. Then he brings him to her father Raguel's house. Tobias has heard the stories.
He's afraid. Who wouldn't be? Husband number eight.

teach.h: THE SMOKE, AND THE DEMON BOUND.
teach.b: Raguel agrees, the contract is written, there's a meal. Then the young couple are shown to their room.
Tobias does what Raphael told him: he puts part of the fish from the Tigris on the coals, the smoke drives the demon away, and Raphael binds it far off in the desert of Egypt.
And then, before anything else, Tobias turns to his bride and says, in effect: Sara, get up.

Let's pray, the two of us, that the Lord will have mercy on us. And they pray together. The prayer remembers where marriage began: God made Adam, gave him Eve as a helper, and said it isn't good for the man to be alone.
Tobias says he's taking Sara not out of lust but in truth, with a sincere heart.

teach.h: MERCY, AND TO GROW OLD TOGETHER.
teach.b: They ask God for mercy, and to grow old together. In the Latin text the Douay follows, they go further and spend three nights in prayer before they sleep together. The Greek text keeps the prayer short.
Either way, the first thing these two did as a married couple was pray. Meanwhile, down the hall, poor Raguel has been up in the night, quietly digging a grave, just in case.
In the morning he sends a maid to peek in, and she finds them both asleep and well.

teach.h: A GRAVE DUG, THEN FILLED IN.
teach.b: So he has the grave filled in before anyone sees it, blesses God, and throws a wedding feast.
This prayer of Tobias and Sara is one of the readings couples can choose for a Catholic wedding.

games.q: you're Tobias. you've just married a woman whose seven husbands all died on the wedding night. you're alone with her now. what do you do first?
o: turn to her and say: let's pray together.
games.why: before anything else, Tobias and Sara pray: they remember Adam and Eve, ask for mercy, and ask to grow old together.

practice: If someone you love is near and willing, sit together and pray something you both know, an Our Father, or simply share a moment of silence side by side.

If you're alone, think of the person you'd most want beside you, and picture sitting down together before the day's business begins, the way Tobias and Sara did. If you pray, ask God's mercy on the two of you.
